script_text: Gemini and Virgo aren't boring—they're a live wire and a precision instrument. Gemini is air: fast, curious, hungry for options; Virgo is earth: grounded, useful, allergic to chaos. On November 23, the Sun in Sagittarius opposes Gemini's 7th-house love zone and squares Virgo's 10th-house career, so attraction tests reputation. Gemini's Venus wants banter and freedom; Virgo's Mars rewards effort, so playful teasing can feel like neglect. Both are Mercury-ruled, but Gemini spreads ideas through the 3rd house. Virgo edits them in the 6th, so misunderstandings flare when analysis sounds like criticism. With Saturn in Aries, this lasts if Gemini supports Virgo's 10th-house career climb. Mercury's sextile to Saturn can turn witty plans into paid projects. Secret tip: Virgo must request attention before resentment becomes an audit. Comment your partner's sign!
